title: Additive Postnikov exact couples for a cohomological functor
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], with derived category $D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and its standard cohomology and truncations [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Let $T^0:D(\mathcal A)\to\mathcal B$ be an additive homological functor [def-sp-homological-functor], and put $T^n(M)=T^0(M[n])$ with the canonical coherent shift comparisons. Thus the boundary for a distinguished triangle $X\to Y\to Z\xrightarrow{w}X[1]$ is $T^0(w[n]):T^n(Z)\to T^{n+1}(X)$.
For $L\in D(\mathcal A)$ form the bigraded objects
$$D^{p,q}(L)=T^{p+q}(\tau_{\le q}L),\qquad E^{p,q}(L)=T^{p+q}(H^q(L)[-q]).$$
Let $\alpha:D^{p,q}\to D^{p-1,q+1}$ come from the next truncation inclusion, $g:D^{p,q}\to E^{p,q}$ from the canonical quotient, and $f:E^{p,q}\to D^{p+2,q-1}$ from the boundary of the successive truncation triangle. These objects and maps form an exact couple [def-sp-exact-couple]. Iteration gives an $E_2$ spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence], $E_2=E$, with $d_s$ of bidegree $(s,1-s)$ and $E_{s+1}^{p,q}=\ker(d_s\text{ out})/\operatorname{im}(d_s\text{ in})$. Its initial page has the natural identification $E_2^{p,q}\cong T^p(H^q(L)[0])$.
For every morphism $u:L\to L'$ the maps obtained by applying $T$ to the canonical truncation and cohomology maps form a morphism of exact couples. The induced maps on all iterated couples, pages and stabilized pages preserve identities and composition and are additive in $u$.
If $\rho$ is any fixed integer and both couples, reindexed by $\widetilde D^{P,Q}=D^{P-\rho,Q}$, $\widetilde E^{P,Q}=E^{P-\rho,Q}$, satisfy the hypotheses of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence], these page maps are compatible with the canonical abutment maps and image filtrations [def-sp-filtration, def-sp-convergence] of that theorem and with its stable-page/graded identifications. The induced maps on each filtration subobject and associated graded piece are also additive in $u$. All these compatibilities persist under transport along an additive natural isomorphism from the canonical abutment functors to other additive functors.

proof.text: Construct the normalized initial Postnikov couple, then its additive page diagram. Realize those pages as the spectral sequence, construct its stabilized-entry functors and natural half-plane abutment independently, and transport the latter along each additive natural comparison by its image filtration.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NA-98e1ded81 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, its 9 steps and the one new node in full. The item's statement and stmt_deps are identical to the live copy, where the item is still unsplit; no other group has superseded it, and there is no SGA citation. Indexing, checked by hand with n=p+q: alpha=T^n(i_{q+1}) lands in D^{p-1,q+1}, g=T^n(j_q), f=T^n(k_q) lands in T^{n+1}(A_{q-1})=D^{p+2,q-1}. The incoming E-term at D^{p,q} is E^{p-2,q+1}=T^{n-1}(C_{q+1}), and all three positions match def-sp-exact-couple; the (-1)^n shift sign changes no kernel or image. Each cited node states what its step uses: lem-weil-pbc-truncation-triangle gives the triangle for any abelian A and a morphism of triangles for every morphism of D(A); lem-sp-long-exact-of-triangle needs only a homological functor; lem-sp-derived-couple-exact clause 4 gives the iteration, d_r of bidegree (r,1-r) and E_2=E; lem-sp-derived-couple-functoriality gives the induced maps on derived couples and all pages; lem-sp-couple-morphism gives filtration and graded compatibility without requiring equal lower bounds. Reindexing by rho keeps all bidegrees. Steps 3, 6, 8 and 9 are genuinely elementary (shift-comparison naturality; mono/epi cancellation for additivity of image, filtration and graded maps; transport along eta). Step 5's induction is set up with step 4 as its base. New leaf lem-per-derived-standard-functors-additive: every declaration and line checked in Mathlib (TruncLEGT.lean:40-42 truncLE Additive; HomologySequence.lean:104-106 IsHomological plus HomologicalFunctor.lean:153-154 the inferred Additive instance; Basic.lean:164-167 shift; Basic.lean:245-247 singleFunctor). Advisory: Mathlib's t-structure truncLE versus the subcomplex truncation is a natural isomorphism, which preserves additivity — one line, acceptable under B8. Duplicate searches (rg -L for additive/truncation/shift, the Mathlib instance names, Postnikov, exact couple) found nothing matching: the pbc truncation-couple nodes are specific to g^{-1}Rf_*, pod-fixed-pair works with a bounded t-structure, and sibling lem-per-postnikov-finite-cutoff-abutment assumes the couple and complements the item. Small cases checked: L=0, T=0, L=F[-q0], u=0 and u=id, rho of either sign.
